record.question: In April 2026, Union Minister Nitin Gadkari launched the 'Arogya Van' initiative. What is the primary objective of this project?
options: To create herbal gardens in all central government school.
To establish solar-powered health clinics in rural areas.
To provide free health insurance to forest dwellers.
To plant medicinal trees on vacant land parcels along National Highways.
